The trace the excess is measured from is clean for POL-RD-07 purposes and for the POL-RD-08 burden: 205 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. Running the POL-RD-02 recomputation on the recorded constants: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km + 0.28 x 24.0 min) x 1.2 surge, the multiplier read from fare_breakdown EV-FARE-09111 and from nowhere else) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP for the only on-optimal-route gantry (Pioneer Road inbound) + 0.00 waiting_time_fee - 1.00 promo_discount = 24.224 recomputed_fare. Under POL-RD-09(1) that off-route charge is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund, because the recomputed fare admits only gantries lying on the optimal route; it is itemised in the ruling for transparency but must NEVER be added on top of the SGD 9.15. By contrast the Pioneer Road inbound gantry (1.00) is on the optimal route and is properly chargeable, and is the only ERP line carried into the recomputation.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: The GPS trace EV-GPS-09111 is not impaired (205 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps), so the excess is measured from it. The trace and trip record EV-TRIP-09111 agree the completed trip was 16.2 km against the booked optimal 12.0 km — an excess of 4.2 km (35.0%). Both POL-RD-01 establishment gates pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and there is no FULL_REFUND uplift or driver-conduct referral. No exculpatory clause applies: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and cannot support POL-RD-03; the chat log EV-CHAT-09111 shows no rider-requested detour or stop, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable; there is no pickup/dropoff amendment, so POL-RD-05 does not change the baseline; the fare model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance refund.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, using the fare_breakdown EV-FARE-09111 (METERED, surge_multiplier 1.20 read from that artifact):
charged_total = SGD 33.36
recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75×12.0 + 0.28×24.0) × 1.20) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 on-optimal-route ERP (Pioneer Road inbound) + 0.00 waiting − 1.00 promo = SGD 24.224
refund = 33.36 − 24.224 = SGD 9.136, rounded up to SGD 9.15.

The SGD 2.00 off-route ERP for the Tuas South Avenue 8 loop is itemised but already comprehended in this refund and is not added on top (POL-RD-09(1)). The driver's profile shows no repeat-deviation pattern on the only citable fields (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0, completed_trips_90d 610); the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter was not used as a ground (POL-GEN-01). The rider's profile does not trigger any adverse corroboration requirement. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.15.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
